instruction: I need to save information from Wikipedia about Python programming language. Go to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language) and create a new document on the desktop called "python_info.docx". Copy the first paragraph of the article (the introduction before the Contents section) and format the title "Python (programming language)" as centered and bold.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires copying Wikipedia paragraph about Python, creating a docx file, and formatting the title as centered and bold. Evaluator checks: (1) title contains 'Python' and 'programming language' (0.25), (2) title is centered (0.25), (3) title is bold (0.25), (4) content paragraph exists with at least 50 words (0.25). Ensures both content copying and title formatting are verified.

scoring_breakdown.0.25: Title contains correct keywords (Python, programming language)
scoring_breakdown.1.00: Content paragraph copied with at least 50 words

llm_judge_reasons: COMPLETE COVERAGE: Evaluator checks all instruction requirements: (1) title keywords 'Python' and 'programming language' (0.25), (2) title centered (0.25), (3) title bold (0.25), (4) content paragraph with ≥50 words (0.25)
CORRECT LOGIC: Getter extracts both title (first paragraph) and content (subsequent paragraphs), returning structured data with text, formatting, and word count. Metric validates all aspects.
PROPER POSTCONFIG: Activates LibreOffice window and saves file (Ctrl+S) before verification, ensuring file state is fresh
REASONABLE FLEXIBILITY: Uses keyword matching instead of exact title match, making evaluation robust to whitespace/formatting variations

MINOR: Doesn't verify content is actually from Wikipedia article (e.g., checking specific phrases), but this is impractical without external API. Word count ≥50 is reasonable proxy for paragraph copying.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Could add minimum paragraph count check (e.g., total_paragraphs >= 2) to ensure title and content are separate paragraphs, not combined
